name: A pointer parameter without ownership rejects the binding

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Nil { mut pointer = %{}; pointer[:type] = :pointer; pointer[:nullable] = false; mut signature = %{}; signature[:convention] = :c; signature[:parameters] = [pointer]; signature[:result] = :i32; signature[:errors] = :none; let library = FFI.open("libm.so"); library.bind(:copy, signature) } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Binding validation precedes any native invocation.
